theorems.statement: ∀ (μ : ℕ → Measure ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (Λ : ℝ≥0∞), a < b → Λ ≠ ∞ → (∀ j, μ j (Icc a b) ≤ Λ) → ∃ (s : ℝ) (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (C : ℝ≥0∞), a < s ∧ s < b ∧ StrictMono φ ∧ C ≠ ∞ ∧ (∀ j, liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ (φ j) (Ioo (s - h) s)) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ C) ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, μ (φ j) (Icc (s - δ) s) ≤ ε
